item.title: Japan’s ‘Iron Lady’ Takaichi forges historic election win
item.description: TOKYO (Reuters) — Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi's coalition swept to a historic election win on Sunday, paving the way for promised tax cuts that have spooked financial markets and military spending aimed at countering China. The post Japan’s ‘Iron Lady’ Takaichi forges historic election win appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: A cultural icon
item.description: On behalf of the municipality of Saipan, Mayor “RB” Camacho presented a memorial plaque to the family of the late Lino Olopai to pay tribute to his legacy as a cultural beacon and icon of the CNMI. “May his memory and teachings forever inspire our people to preserve and protect our cultural identity,” the mayor said. Office of the Saipan Mayor photo The post A cultural icon appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: Lorna Maramba to enter guilty plea in immigration fraud case
item.description: A WOMAN accused of using two falsified U.S. permanent resident cards to travel from Saipan to Hawaii will plead guilty after the federal court converted her upcoming preliminary hearing into an arraignment and change‑of‑plea proceeding. item.title: Apatang backs King-Hinds bill
item.description: GOVERNOR David M. Apatang said Monday that he is 100% in support of Delegate Kimberlyn King-Hinds’ proposal to extend the CNMI-Only Transitional Worker program for another 10 years. The post Apatang backs King-Hinds bill appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: Governor announces three new judicial appointments
item.description: GOVERNOR David M. Apatang on Monday announced his appointment of three jurists: Superior Court Presiding Judge Roberto C. Naraja as Supreme Court associate justice; Associate Judge Joseph James N. Camacho as presiding judge; and former Attorney General Joey Patrick San Nicolas as associate judge.
